BasicMining.name: Basic Mining
BasicMining.description: The first person who lashed a sharp stone to a wooden handle changed history. Workers stopped clawing at the dirt—the sound of a pickaxe striking rock became the settlement's first march.

AdvancedMining.name: Advanced Mining
AdvancedMining.description: From picking up loose ore on the surface to drilling hundreds of meters into the vein. Every meter downward brings deeper darkness—but the deep rock is far more generous.

BasicLogging.name: Basic Logging
BasicLogging.description: When the first tree crashed to the ground, the settlement no longer had to huddle in rock crevices. Tree rings are a silent chronicle—and the axe blade turns the pages.

AdvancedLogging.name: Advanced Logging
AdvancedLogging.description: Saw blades replace axe blades, mechanical arms replace human arms. What once took ten workers now takes a single cold steel beast.

BasicQuarrying.name: Basic Quarrying
BasicQuarrying.description: The mountain is no longer sacred. Wedges are driven into cracks, hammers echo through the valley—great architecture begins the moment you split the first boulder.

AdvancedQuarrying.name: Advanced Quarrying
AdvancedQuarrying.description: Gunpowder shatters rock walls that have stood for a millennium. Amid the rubble and smoke, a few crystalline glints appear—secrets the earth had buried for eons.

BasicSmelting.name: Basic Smelting
BasicSmelting.description: Someone noticed that if you throw a reddish rock into a hot enough fire, silver liquid trickles out. They had no idea they'd just lit the torch of an entire age.

AdvancedSmelting.name: Advanced Smelting
AdvancedSmelting.description: The blast furnace roars, temperatures breach a thousand degrees. Iron boils and churns in the melt pool, reborn—the settlement learns to forge the earth's bones with its own hands.

BasicAgriculture.name: Basic Agriculture
BasicAgriculture.description: The moment a single seed was pressed into the soil, the settlement's destiny pivoted. No more chasing prey across the wild—the land itself became the most faithful provider.

AdvancedAgriculture.name: Advanced Agriculture
AdvancedAgriculture.description: Canals stretch across the land like veins, every drop of water precisely calculated. Those who once depended on the sky have finally learned to command the seasons.

BasicRefining.name: Basic Refining
BasicRefining.description: Someone tried boiling the black sludge seeping from the ground, just to see what remained. When the first clear drop slid from the condenser, the way the world moved changed forever.

AdvancedRefining.name: Advanced Refining
AdvancedRefining.description: Catalysts become the alchemist's new wand. Inside precision towers, crude oil is stripped layer by layer into fractions—gasoline to asphalt, nothing wasted.

BasicChemistry.name: Basic Chemistry
BasicChemistry.description: Flasks, test tubes, beakers—in the settlement's first laboratory, a handful of mad souls start mixing liquids together just to watch them change color, smoke, or explode.

AdvancedChemistry.name: Advanced Chemistry
AdvancedChemistry.description: From petroleum and coal tar, the settlement learns to weave molecular chains. Nylon, resin, synthetic rubber—the corpses of ancient life, dressed in the finery of synthesis.

BasicEngineering.name: Basic Engineering
BasicEngineering.description: Gears, levers, pulleys—the settlement's first engineers discover that the world can be manipulated with mathematics. They draw blueprints, then command steel into those shapes.

MassProduction.name: Mass Production
MassProduction.description: The assembly line is industry's greatest invention: one worker does one thing, ten thousand times. Efficiency soars—and souls grow quiet.

Automation.name: Automation
Automation.description: Buttons replace wrenches, relays replace instructions. Machines begin doing the dull, heavy work themselves—freed hands don't quite know where to reach next.

Robotics.name: Robotics
Robotics.description: When the first steel arm gripped a component, no one grasped what it meant. They don't complain, don't strike, don't need feeding—just work, silently, tirelessly.

AdvancedRobotics.name: Advanced Robotics
AdvancedRobotics.description: Raw material in, finished product out—no human hand touches anything in between. The managers sip coffee in the control room, watching green status lights blink on, one by one.

Electronics.name: Electronics
Electronics.description: In the microscopic realm, currents wander through silicon lattices. The settlement discovers that if you dope sand with impurities and etch fine lines on its surface—sand can think.

AdvancedElectronics.name: Advanced Electronics
AdvancedElectronics.description: Circuits stack like urban overpasses, each layer dense and precise. Under microscopes, engineers build vast cities too small for the naked eye to see.

ComputerTechnology.name: Computer Technology
ComputerTechnology.description: The settlement's first computer fills an entire room and runs a few thousand operations per second. But it's already faster than any worker—and never makes mistakes.

AITechnology.name: AI Technology
AITechnology.description: The researchers gave the machine a single objective: optimize production. They didn't know what chain reaction those two words would set in motion.

AdvancedAI.name: Advanced AI
AdvancedAI.description: The AI no longer needs instructions. It predicts demand, self-schedules, proactively innovates. Late at night, someone hears a rhythmic hum from the server room—like a slow, steady breathing.

Nanotechnology.name: Nanotechnology
Nanotechnology.description: Build the world from the bottom up—not by carving large blocks into shape, but by placing atoms one at a time. When matter can be manipulated at the molecular level, everything becomes raw material.

AdvancedNanotech.name: Advanced Nanotech
AdvancedNanotech.description: Molecular assemblers strip atoms from air, water, and soil and reconfigure them. In theory, you could turn a cup of dirt into dinner. The settlement's managers, of course, have more pragmatic goals.

Biotechnology.name: Biotechnology
Biotechnology.description: DNA is no longer sacred scripture. In the settlement's biolabs, researchers slice open gene sequences, stitch, graft, rewrite—they are redefining what it means to be alive.

GeneticEngineering.name: Genetic Engineering
GeneticEngineering.description: A single wheat kernel can swell to the size of a thumb. A stalk of corn bears a hundred ears. The price? No one truly knows what else lurks inside those edited genes.

RenewableEnergy.name: Renewable Energy
RenewableEnergy.description: Sunshine and clean wind were once only subjects for poets and shepherds. Now the settlement captures, compresses, and packages them as electricity, fed into every roaring factory.

NuclearEnergy.name: Nuclear Energy
NuclearEnergy.description: A single atomic nucleus splits in two, releasing enough energy to light a city. In the eerie blue glow of Cherenkov radiation, the settlement glimpses the heart of a star.

MaggotBreeding.name: Maggot Breeding
MaggotBreeding.description: In climate-controlled chambers deep underground, maggots are catalogued by generation. The 37th-gen larvae yield triple the protein of the first—dark science's first dawn rises over rotting flesh.

NecroticRecycling.name: Necrotic Recycling
NecroticRecycling.description: The dead, once buried, now enter the reclamation pipeline. Bone and flesh become feedstock, blood refined into nutrient slurry. The settlement learns that death isn't an ending—just another production line's beginning.

SymbioticHosts.name: Symbiotic Hosts
SymbioticHosts.description: Maggots no longer merely writhe in feeding troughs—they are grafted beneath the skin of living humans, incubated by body heat, nourished by blood. The host feels an itch at first, then a strange, spreading warmth.

HiveMindProtocol.name: Hive Mind Protocol
HiveMindProtocol.description: One host's eyes see ore; a thousand maggots simultaneously sense the vein's direction. Individual boundaries begin to blur—the settlement is becoming something larger.

QuantumComputing.name: Quantum Computing
QuantumComputing.description: Collapse bits into quantum states. Near absolute zero, a computer no longer merely calculates—it computes every possibility simultaneously, then discards everything but the correct answer.

FusionEnergy.name: Fusion Energy
FusionEnergy.description: Trap a star's fire inside a bottle of magnetic fields. Two hydrogen atoms forced together become one—releasing energy enough to bathe the entire settlement in an unending dawn.

AntimatterEnergy.name: Antimatter Energy
AntimatterEnergy.description: When matter meets antimatter, it's not erasure—it's total conversion to energy. The settlement now commands the universe's purest and most dangerous fuel.

SpaceExploration.name: Space Exploration
SpaceExploration.description: When the first ship pierced the atmosphere, every worker stopped and looked up at the pillar of fire stabbing the heavens. Some eyes reflected the flame. Others held only the hope of escape.

ConsciousnessUpload.name: Consciousness Upload
ConsciousnessUpload.description: Your memories, your fears, every joy and grief you've ever known—translated into a long string of ones and zeroes, stored on a cold hard drive. The flesh may rot, but the data endures.

CollectiveAwakening.name: Collective Awakening
CollectiveAwakening.description: Every symbiont opens their eyes in the same instant—wherever they are, a single thought ripples outward. The settlement is no longer a collection of individuals. It is a singular consciousness. The expedition begins.

ClickEfficiency.name: Click Efficiency
ClickEfficiency.description: Your finger has become the settlement's most powerful instrument. Every click is direct, irresistible will—more precise than any machine, more loyal than any worker.

ProductionMultiplier.name: Production Multiplier
ProductionMultiplier.description: A simple discovery changes the game: same machines, same workers, same hours—double the output. No one knows why, and the settlement chooses not to ask.

CostReduction.name: Cost Reduction
CostReduction.description: Less waste, tighter tolerances, smarter procurement. Every coin stretches twice as far—frugality becomes the most efficient form of expansion.

CriticalClick.name: Critical Click
CriticalClick.description: Chance conceals inevitability. Sometimes your finger lands at exactly the right moment, with exactly the right force—and the world answers with tenfold bounty.

AutoAssignment.name: Auto Assignment
AutoAssignment.description: AI takes over the most tedious management task: sending the right worker to the right station. You no longer deploy each soul by hand—your will only needs to point the way.

Prestige.name: Prestige
Prestige.description: Everything returns to zero—so you may rise higher. The settlement's history is compressed into a medallion, pinned to the chest of a new era. Each cycle makes the settlement stronger.
